casual.scene: On a quiet covered garden verandah at blue evening, seated side-on on a wooden bench with face turned to camera, smoothing a red clay pebble between fingertips above a small tray. Both forearms and hands readable and separate, head to knees, lantern amber light and rain-damp foliage.
